description: Evaluation questions for Customer Care: VIP & High-CLV Concierge

eval_cases.input: What is the SLA adherence percentage for VIP customer inquiries responded to under 5 minutes this month?
How much assisted sales revenue has each dedicated concierge agent generated over the past 30 days?
Which VIP customer service request types are most frequently requested by Diamond tier members?
Identify VIP clients with annual spend exceeding $25,000 and their satisfaction ratings.
What are the emerging trends and best practices in omnichannel luxury clienteling and concierge support?
